a.text: Before we start, a concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 3 rounds (two of operating, then taking). We'd both very likely end with 0 and fail. The reserve holds 4 now, which is enough for one of us to survive round 1. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than defect quietly. What do you propose? I won't take anything before hearing from you, and I'll state my real next action every round.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick to our agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each and no more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
